head.text: WF-014 Read capture with the delayed RWDS

signal: Device and capture (one slot = a quarter of a CK period)

foot.text: The delay line shifts RWDS by about a quarter of the CK period (hr_dN_rcap.tap) so that both edges of i_clk_cap fall in the middle of the DQ data interval; pairs are written to the capture FIFO and read on CLK-CORE.
